title: Identifying stakeholders and what each one needs to see

videos.script: Caio asks Lívia for a delivery dashboard. The easy thing is to ask Caio what he wants and build it. {{ask}} Two months later, nine store managers are disputing the number, because their bonus depends on it, and nobody asked them anything. This lesson is about the people around a number. {{who}} First, who they are. Some decide, some influence, some are affected, and some provide the data. The one nobody listed is usually the one who stops the project. {{map}} Then the map. Power on one axis, interest on the other, and four ways of spending your time. {{views}} Then what each person needs to see. Helena wants one number a month. Marcos wants a list of orders, right now. Same definition, four different pages. {{talk}} Last, the conversation. The questions to ask, the drawing to show before you build, and what to do when two directors want the same number defined two different ways.
